name: JWH-081
summary: JWH-081 is an analgesic chemical from the naphthoylindole family, which acts as a cannabinoid agonist at both the CB1 and CB2 receptors.4nM). It was discovered by and named after John W. Huffman.

pharmacology.text: JWH-081 is an analgesic chemical from the naphthoylindole family, which acts as a cannabinoid agonist at both the CB1 and CB2 receptors. With a Ki of 1.2nM it is fairly selective for the CB1 subtype, its affinity at this subtype is measured at approximately 10x the affinity at CB2(12.4nM).

summaryZh: JWH-081，化學名N-正戊基-3-(4-甲氧基-1-萘甲醯基)吲哚，分子式C25H25NO2，屬於萘甲醯基吲哚類JWH系列大麻素，是大麻素受體CB1和CB2的激動劑。
summaryZhHans: JWH-081，化学名N-正戊基-3-(4-甲氧基-1-萘甲酰基)吲哚，分子式C25H25NO2，属于萘甲酰基吲哚类JWH系列大麻素，是大麻素受体CB1和CB2的激动剂。
